_comment: Every Book of Shapes pattern judged against the 17 generators in blog#138. verdict: covered = shipped | variation = a parameter away from something we have | port = a mechanism nothing has, worth building | skip = mismatch. `family` names the mechanism, which is what separates a variation from a new generator. See EVALUATION.md.

families.iso-cubes: iso-cubes + a height-field source, a carve mask, or a face treatment
families.mesh-mode: any lattice, drawn as a connected wireframe instead of as marks
families.radial-ring: radial-spokes / broken-ring / modular-circle with different cell counts and weights
families.disorder: already covered — the disorder ramp on an existing lattice generator
families.wave-envelope: contour + an amplitude/frequency envelope across the frame
families.interference: interference + mark type and source count
families.field-source: flow-field / flow-lines + a field built from poles instead of a formula
families.distinct: a mechanism nothing in the set has

brockmann_arcs.why: Corrected: a few very thick concentric arc segments — broken-ring with 3-4 cells per band.

chevron_blocks.why: Corrected: not 'ruled hexagons' but striped-face isometric cubes. Face treatment on iso-cubes.
